name: dth-phc

scripts.check:l1-coverage:warn: bun run check:l1-coverage || echo 'WARN: L1 coverage is OPEN; the site publish continues (owner, Q-PHC13 A). The PR gate runs check:l1-coverage strictly.'
scripts.check:figures: python3 scripts/figures/fig1_paper_to_digital.py --check && python3 scripts/figures/fig4_collect_once.py --check && python3 scripts/figures/fig12_data_element_needed.py --check && python3 scripts/figures/table_figure.py --check
scripts.review:anchors: bun run folio-assistant-core/scripts/review-anchors-from-folio.ts --document dth-phc --library 9789240093362-eng --source who-iris/library/9789240093362-eng/structure.json --source-label "the WHO IRIS L1 entry it was seeded from"
scripts.check:review-anchors: bun run folio-assistant-core/scripts/review-anchors-from-folio.ts --document dth-phc --library 9789240093362-eng --source who-iris/library/9789240093362-eng/structure.json --source-label "the WHO IRIS L1 entry it was seeded from" --check

_workspaces_comment: The mounted code layers, as workspaces, as smart-ra and folio-assistant list them: they import each other by package name (@litlfred/cat-harness-tools, ...), and nothing publishes those packages, so a mount resolves them only through the ONE root node_modules that bunfig.toml's hoisted linker lays out. Without this, fhir-harness's scripts could not find @litlfred/cat-harness-tools and check:review-anchors, site:document and the CI publish failed (dth-hrh#41).
